title.narrative: Creating a Gender Responsive Trading Environment

description.narrative: The project aims at strengthening Capacity of cross-border traders at Rusizi II to increase their income, improve trade environment and support them to trade formally. This will be achieved through providing skills and sound knowledge on laws and policies governing cross border trade and also psychosocial support. The project activities will be implemented in Rusizi District, at Rusizi II border and neighbouring administrative sectors of Mururu, Nyakarenzo, Gashonga and Rwimbogo.
